snippet.title: Dojo Raiders | Intro Trailer
snippet.description:
Dojo Raiders is a streamer-led community battle game where streamers play live with their viewers on Twitch!


The game can be played both as a main game or as a side game alongside the streamer's main content, with fast-paced battles taking place every 15 minutes. The streamer is the “Sensei” and viewers join the fight as dojo students. Pick your weapon, lock in your strategy, and join the battle—but choose wisely, as each viewer can only enter once per match! Progress through campaign maps together to collect rewards, unlock new weapons, and level-up your character!

Join our Alpha test today, complete your battlepass and get your pre-launch free skin!

Official Website: www.dojoraiders.com
Official Discord Community: https://discord.gg/rg5YNpCbQ
